clauses.reason: whole: The order directs that the designation of Gastonia, North Carolina, as a customs port of entry "it is hereby, revoked" and the words of effectiveness (printed across two lines) make the revocation effective the date of the order, which is signed March 3, 1943. It is a one-time command performed that day, so the order is exhausted by performance on 1943-03-03 and the designation stays revoked as a surviving consequence. The order has no sunset, report or continuing duty.
